generated_output.summary: When background playback is interrupted by a third-party audio or video application (such as Poweramp), PiliPlus pauses the playback via audio session interruption events but fails to automatically resume playback once the interruption event ends.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The audio session interruption listener tracks `_playInterrupted = true` when an interruption pause begins. However, when the interruption ends (`event.begin` is false), the `AudioInterruptionType.pause` case checks `if (_playInterrupted) PlPlayerController.playIfExists();`, but `_playInterrupted` may not be correctly evaluated or reset under certain audio session state transitions, or the underlying player state check needs proper synchronization.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect Audio Session Interruption Handler
step_by_step_plan.description: Examine the audio interruption event listener in `lib/services/audio_session.dart` under AudioSessionHandler to understand how `_playInterrupted` state is set when `event.begin` is true and how it is checked when `event.begin` is false.

step_by_step_plan.title: Fix Interruption End State Restoration
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify the `AudioInterruptionType.pause` handling when `event.begin` is false in `lib/services/audio_session.dart` to ensure `_playInterrupted` is properly verified, `PlPlayerController.playIfExists()` is correctly invoked, and `_playInterrupted` is safely reset to false.

step_by_step_plan.title: Implement Regression Test
step_by_step_plan.description: Add a unit or widget test simulating audio session interruption events (pause begin followed by interruption end) to verify that background playback automatically resumes when the interruption ends.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run Test Suite
step_by_step_plan.description: Execute the project test command to ensure the audio session interruption fix passes successfully without introducing regressions.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Handling system events when another app takes over the device audio output.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Mobile operating systems notify apps when audio focus is lost or gained so media players can pause and resume gracefully.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The issue stems from the interruption event stream not correctly resuming playback when the third-party interruption ends.

structured_concepts.concept_name: State Flag Tracking in Event Streams
structured_concepts.short_explanation: Using boolean flags to track whether an application was actively playing before an external event occurred.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Ensures the app only resumes playback if it was actually playing when interrupted, rather than blindly restarting playback when stopped by the user.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The `_playInterrupted` boolean flag controls whether playback should resume when the interruption ends.

common_pitfalls: Resuming playback even if the user manually paused the video before the interruption occurred.
Failing to reset `_playInterrupted` after handling the resume action.
